text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh!
...Heh... As expected of my little sister...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—...Let's go, Vivlos!!
Toward your dream...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
!!
Yeaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
――YAAAAAAAHHH!!
――HAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—A dream showdown between sisters!
And the result is...—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Nnnngh.

text_block_list.name: Young Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—Vivlos!
Try and keep up!

text_block_list.name: Young Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Onee-chan!
Onee-chan~~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
She made that big sis...
get serious...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I am,
suuuuuper amazing!!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —That's true.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Good work, Vivlos!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big sis...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"You've gotten strong.
...Very strong."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehe, right~?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: You know, that was sooooo much fun! Thanks for fighting alongside me!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Me too.
Running with you felt... somehow..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Did that sort of clear the air?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, nailed it!
Onee-chan, I didn't know you could make a face like that!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't really feel like an 'older sister'～...
More like just 'Verxina-chan'♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Don't tease me.
...Still, it really was fun.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"It's true that a weight has been lifted off my chest.
I really am always receiving things from you, aren't I?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No! I got one too.
A wonderful cheer... from big sister!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best!
Toward my dream...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Both of you are amazing.
Unlike... someone like me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Still...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Still... even I...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
These are my beloved big sisters! ♡
Hey, hey, aren't they both super great?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
After all, I'm their little sister.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
To my beloved, precious big sis!
I want to show her!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —I'm your older sister... too.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Cheva-chiiii~~~?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... I can't find them, though.
They definitely came, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Cheva-chi, I managed somehow!
I actually ran with that super amazing big sis!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It'll definitely work out
for you too, Cheva-chi~~~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Because you're
my big sister!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Vivlos.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —...I have to keep moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I'll become stronger—so I can be proud of myself.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Trainy-poo~~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big sis and I had a super great run!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No way~!
Praise me, won't ya?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Nihehe~♡
Trainie, you've gotten so good at complimenting me♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if Cheva-chi
was watching too?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I wonder if that managed to cheer them up...
choice_data_list: I'm sure your feelings reached them.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: You're right.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainie, you know what?
I really want to go to Dubai next year after all!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: It's my precious dream, and everyone's cheering for me!
I'll develop and condition my body even further over this coming year. If I make steady progress, I'll surely become an Umamusume capable of enduring the harsh overseas expeditions.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yup,
take me with you!
choice_data_list: For the next race, one leading up to Dubai would be good.
For the next race, one leading up to Dubai would be nice.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ooooh?!

Looking at distance, racecourses, and past history,
there are races that could lead to Dubai, but
if I were to make a proposal to her right now...
choice_data_list: Choosing by "opponent" might not be a bad idea.
Choosing by "opponent" might not be a bad idea.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"An opponent?
Why?"
Among the current Senior Class Umamusume, there are those with overseas racing experience... and others aiming to compete abroad.

One is Satono Crown.
She is a member of the Satono family, which produces many prominent Umamusume, and she has race experience in Hong Kong.
The other is Satono Diamond... She belongs to the same Satono family and is in the same generation as Vivlos. She's aiming for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
There was one race where both of them announced their entries simultaneously. That race was—
choice_data_list: Why don't you run in the Takarazuka Kinen?
Why don't you run in the Takarazuka Kinen?

text_block_list.text:
"The Takarazuka Kinen is the Kansai region's Grand Prix race.
Carrying the dreams of both people and Umamusume,
this race will lead directly into our dream of Dubai."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It's like...
a brand-new chapter, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Got it, let's go with the Takarazuka Kinen.
Actually, wait...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Looking at this lineup,
it feels like a celebrity commemorative event~?!
And so, the next target race was decided: the Takarazuka Kinen!
